notes: POC focused on embeddings + reranking for product search across large catalog (currently ~12M SKUs planned, peak seasonal index ~18M). Primary objective: reduce false positives in results and push conversion via reranking while keeping cost-per-query <= $0.005 on average. Team is engineering-first; wants plug-and-play embedding store plus an offline/online rerank flow (dense recall -> cross-encoder rerank). Concerned about query latency under seasonal spikes: target p95 end-to-end (query->rerank->response) <= 250ms (95th) for desktop, 350ms for mobile. Considering hybrid approach: Redwood hosted API for dev + Dedicated pools for production traffic with VPC peering. Security: SSO + enterprise KMS, audit logs, and EU data residency for EU traffic. Quote from head of search: "Need predictable unit economics during Black Friday spikes — can't have cost blowouts for a 10x traffic day."

requirements_summary: Large-scale semantic search for e-commerce catalog. Must support incremental indexing (hourly deltas) and full reindexes. Want embedding storage optimized for cost (quantization/compaction) and a rerank path that can be batched for cold queries and synchronous for top-K live sessions. Strong need for cache strategies and prefix/KV caching for popular queries during promotions. Routing: prefer region-aware routing (NA/EU), fallback to lower-cost model variant if capacity constrained. SLA asked: 99.5% availability and predictable SLOs for latency during seasonal peaks.
technical_constraints: Catalog size expected to grow to 18M SKUs in 6 months. Typical item metadata size 2-5KB, embeddings 1536-d float16 target. Retention for embeddings: 90 days active, cold storage after. Compliance: EU subset must stay in EU. No air-gapped requirement but strict VPC/KMS controls. Current infra: GCP us-central1 + EU-west1 stores, Kafka-based changefeed for SKU updates.
cost_sensitivity_and_goals: CFO wants modeled cost-per-query ceilings: baseline <$0.0035, 3x <$0.0045, 10x peak <$0.006 to keep margins acceptable during BF/Cyber. Looking for Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) and a clear tradeoff table: latency vs cost vs quality.
poc_success_criteria: 1) Recall@100 >= 0.92 vs baseline Elasticsearch hybrid; 2) Rerank lift: +5% relative CTR on top 5; 3) End-to-end p95 rerank latency <= 250ms on sample traffic; 4) Modeled cost-per-query within finance limits for 10x spike.
integration_notes: Will expose store search endpoint via existing storefront API gateway. Engineering expects Redwood SDK + server-side batching adapter. Data feed via S3 dump for POC + Kafka incremental hook for production. Want A/B/Canary routing in Redwood Console for a 10% traffic split initially.

deal_risks: Legal data residency addendum may push to Private deploy if terms not met. Engineering bandwidth could delay POC. If cost model exceeds finance thresholds, deal will re-enter procurement and likely shift to phased rollout.
